highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled renderer and modernizes support across Windows, Apple, Uno, and Android.
highlights_body: It also improves image and text-processing efficiency, fixes native stream lifetime handling, and hardens managed string conversion.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled renderer with upstream Chrome m156 fixes.

bullets.lead: Native string data is read safely
bullets.detail: FromCString now avoids reading past its native buffer and writes directly into SKData.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android presentation.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing avoid unnecessary work
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string decoding now reduce intermediate native allocations.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention so native stream resources can be released when no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Bundled HarfBuzz symbols load reliably on Linux
bullets.detail: Binds bundled HarfBuzz functions locally so Linux applications consistently use the packaged native implementation.
Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7 and includes WebGPU support directly in the WebAssembly native library.
Aligns Windows library dependencies with MAUI 9 and 10, and updates the Windows toolchain and ANGLE dependency.
Updates the minimum supported Apple platform versions for current platform tooling.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Uno Platform 7 support and WebGPU support in the WebAssembly native library
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Linux HarfBuzz binding reliability and browser sample test coverage
